description: Product lifecycle registry. Every feature treated as a product with gated stages: idea → researching → designing → under_review → rework → approved → building → verifying → shipped.

stage_gates.under_review_to_rework: Antagonist verdict = NEEDS_REWORK → routes back to designing dept
stage_gates.rework_to_under_review: Department addresses all BLOCKER items, resubmits design
stage_gates.approved_to_building: Human approval granted (if approval gate triggered) OR autonomous proceed
stage_gates.building_to_verifying: BUILD complete, DEPT_VERIFY called with changed file list
stage_gates.verifying_to_rework: Verify verdict = REWORK → routes back to BUILD dept

products.name: Campaign Release Network Fix
products.description: campaign-release/index.ts hardcodes network='testnet'. Mainnet escrows never auto-release.

idea.description: Blast radius audit found hardcoded testnet at campaign-release/index.ts:138

approved.note: Small targeted fix — known root cause, pre-approved. No R&D phase needed for bug fixes with clear root cause.

products.name: CauseApply Auth Gate
products.description: Unauthenticated users can fill the entire cause application form, only failing on submit due to RLS.

idea.description: Blast radius audit: no auth check in CauseApply.tsx, RLS rejects unauthenticated inserts silently

approved.note: Clear fix: redirect to /auth?next=/causes/apply if no session. Pre-approved, no R&D needed.

products.name: GitHub Agent File Path Whitelist
products.description: github-agent allows arbitrary file reads from the repo. AI Panel admins could request .env files or secret-adjacent paths.

idea.description: Security audit: no path filtering in github-agent read_file action

approved.note: Clear fix: allowlist src/, supabase/, docs/ paths. Reject anything else. Pre-approved.

products.name: Liquidity Pools (XRPL AMM)
products.description: Pools.tsx is a 100% stub. Build XRPL AMM-based liquidity pools: create, deposit, withdraw, view TVL/APY. Major new feature — full lifecycle required.

idea.description: Stub page identified in audit. Core DeFi feature for the platform. Full R&D → Design → Antagonist → Build → Verify cycle required.

products.name: Professionals Directory
products.description: Professionals.tsx has no data source. Decide: build a real directory (DB table + edge function + search/filter UI) or remove from nav until ready.

idea.description: Page exists in nav but renders no real data. Need R&D to define what a professional is, how they are verified, and what the user flow looks like.

registry_notes: Bug fixes with a clear, isolated root cause skip R&D and Design phases (pre-approved)
New features always go through the full lifecycle: R&D → Design → Antagonist → Approved → Build → Verify → Shipped
Artifacts for each product live in .claude/products/{product_id}/
ROSETTA.md Agent Notes section is updated by DEPT_VERIFY on every SHIPPED verdict
